text: {"contradictions":[{"a":"minitabantur horribile malum exitium, si Christo suam sponsam denegaret.","b":"minabantur horrenda mala et exitium, si filiam Christo negaret.","kind":"role","why":"A says the father would deny his bride (the daughter) to Christ; B says he would deny the daughter to Christ.","certainty":"high"},{"a":"Non, sed passa sum quiddam tam horrendum","b":"Minime, sed passus sum aliquid tam horrendum","kind":"number","why":"A uses feminine 'passa' (the speaker is Virgo), B uses masculine 'passus'.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.a: minitabantur horribile malum exitium, si Christo suam sponsam denegaret.
contradictions.b: minabantur horrenda mala et exitium, si filiam Christo negaret.
contradictions.why: A says the father would deny his bride (the daughter) to Christ; B says he would deny the daughter to Christ.

contradictions.a: Non, sed passa sum quiddam tam horrendum
contradictions.b: Minime, sed passus sum aliquid tam horrendum
contradictions.why: A uses feminine 'passa' (the speaker is Virgo), B uses masculine 'passus'.
